# Depikt

> Depikt is a reference library and prompt workspace for ChatGPT Images. It turns rough ideas and reference images into image-ready prompts for ChatGPT Images 2.5, critiques existing prompts, and keeps a curated collection of 500 GPT Image 2 prompt examples. Depikt writes and reviews prompts; it does not generate images. Free, no login.

## Core tools

- [Library](https://depikt.app/library): The GPT Image 2 collection: 500 curated prompt examples across 10 categories (posters, infographics, UI mockups, social posts, cinematic, product, illustrations, image edits, multi-panel, and more), each with a thumbnail and a "why it works" note. These were written for GPT Image 2; use them to learn, copy, or remix. A separate ChatGPT Images 2.5 collection is planned.
- [Prompt Builder](https://depikt.app/generate): Describe what you want, optionally attach a reference image and say how it should be used (style, subject/identity, edit source, product, composition, sketch/layout). Depikt analyzes the intent (format, ratio, exact text, reference use, series, missing facts), then writes one precise prompt for ChatGPT Images 2.5 with a "why it works" explanation. Open the result in ChatGPT (Imago) to make the image; re-attach the same reference image there when the prompt depends on one.
- [Prompt Critic](https://depikt.app/critique): Paste any image prompt (optionally with its source or reference image). Depikt scores it for ChatGPT Images 2.5 across intent fidelity, clarity, contradictions, composition, reference handling, edit preservation, text and layout, style coherence, factual integrity, and efficiency, lists weaknesses and concrete improvements, and returns a rewritten prompt.
- [Reference Gallery](https://depikt.app/gallery): Hand-picked reference images. Click any image to send it to the Prompt Builder as a reference.

## ChatGPT Images 2.5 guides (September 2026)

OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.5 on September 8, 2026. These guides separate official model changes from ChatGPT features, and explain how each one changes the prompt you write. Depikt's Prompt Builder and Prompt Critic are tuned for this model.

- [ChatGPT Images 2.5: What's New and What It Means for Prompting](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-whats-new): The launch, sorted into model changes, ChatGPT features (Sketch, Templates, comments, shared prompts), and API models (gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst), with what each means for prompting.
- [How to Prompt ChatGPT Images 2.5](https://depikt.app/blog/how-to-prompt-chatgpt-images-2-5): The six-part prompt structure (intent, subject, composition and ratio, exact text, style, constraints) with five before-and-after rewrites.
- [Precise Edits and Reference Images in ChatGPT Images 2.5](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-precise-edits-reference-images): The five reference intents, CHANGE / PRESERVE / MATCH edit prompts, Sketch as a layout reference, and a routine for multi-turn edits without drift.
- [Posters, Infographics, and Slides with ChatGPT Images 2.5](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-posters-infographics-slides): Exact text, hierarchy, data captions with sources, transparent backgrounds, and presentation slides.
- [ChatGPT Images 2.5 Prompt Examples: 12 Recipes](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-prompt-examples): Twelve complete prompts across posters, product photos, infographics, UI mockups, storyboards, edits, and reference images.

- [Blog](https://depikt.app/blog): Field-tested techniques for getting better AI images. Frameworks, examples, model comparisons.

## About

- Built for designers, marketers, indie founders, and creative engineers who want sharp prompts without spending an hour iterating.
- Depikt does not generate images. Prompts are used in ChatGPT Images (for example through the Imago GPT) or any image workflow that accepts a text prompt.
- Free to use. No login required.
- Contact: hi@depikt.app
